title: Tzatziki
subtitle: Gyro sauce, aka yogurt sauce

keyPhoto.alt: Kevin at the kitchen counter with a red bowl of fresh tzatziki next to a big tin of Kalamata olive oil

steps.text: Pour off any liquid from the yogurt.
Peel the cucumber, slice it in half lengthwise, and spoon out the seeds.
Grate the cucumber into a bowl, then squeeze out the extra liquid.
Add all the ingredients and mix well. Add a little salt to taste, plus a pinch or sprinkle of pepper.

notes: Tzatziki is great on all types of meat, especially chicken or pork souvlaki.
Our son Kevin Peter, who served a mission in Greece, says our homemade is delicious.
Our family even puts it on hot dogs!
